authorization: Kevin: Ok go forth, after the proposed matched annual/variability/monthly by equal-cell/soft-weight comparison, 4 October 2026.
seed_schedule: base + 100*species_index + fold, identical to both existing monthly arms
borders: Exact prefixes of frozen parent monthly cutoffs; common columns, training-only 61-column bank from before original sampling intervention. No new quantization.
weights: Reuse all 21 frozen 10-km linear distance-taper vectors; every original presence remains. Equal and soft presence mass each sum to N; background mass N and effective damping .03*N unchanged.
monthly_reuse: Reuse all 42 existing equal/soft monthly slots only after checking source split, seed, model setting, feature order, cutoff identity, membership and frozen weights. No monthly refits or adopted best procedure.
primary_question: Does the fixed-shallow monthly-minus-variability increment change under the existing declustering weights?
interaction: For each fold: (monthly - variability)_soft - (monthly - variability)_equal; then equal fold means within each unit.
primary_score: Equal recorded-50km-block mean within held fold, then equal folds; preserve every fold.
secondary_scores: Source average precision at artificial 1:1 mass
held_design: Same 21 development folds, held presences, full native held areas, source uncertainty, guards and background integration as both saved monthly arms.
inference: Fixed learner and one inherited weighting support; tests representation-by-weighting sensitivity. Does not retune the original selected/fallback pipeline, recover effort or provide independent confirmation.
stop: Complete at most 84 new fits and the 42 verified monthly reuses. Save one summary table/figure and every fold. Accept positive, null, mixed or adverse interaction; stop without scale, learner, feature, full-data or hindcast sweeps.
